recognize_zh: 中性球細胞質邊緣有一小塊淡藍色、邊界清楚的包涵體（箭頭處，類似 Döhle body），旁邊可見體積偏大的血小板；包涵體加上巨大血小板是 May-Hegglin 異常（MYH9 相關疾病）的典型組合。
features: Segmented neutrophil with a discrete pale-blue, spindle/oval cytoplasmic inclusion near the cell membrane (arrow)
Inclusion is larger and more sharply defined than a typical reactive Döhle body
Neutrophil granulation otherwise normal, without toxic granulation or vacuoles
Enlarged platelets adjacent to the neutrophil
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil containing a well-demarcated pale-blue cytoplasmic inclusion at the periphery of the cell (arrow). The neutrophil otherwise shows normal granulation without toxic changes. Large platelets are present nearby, and the red cells are unremarkable. In the setting of thrombocytopenia, findings are consistent with May-Hegglin anomaly (MYH9-related disorder).

ddx.vs: Reactive Döhle bodies are smaller and fainter, and they come with toxic granulation or vacuolization without giant platelets.
Also has giant platelets with thrombocytopenia, but neutrophils lack inclusions and platelets do not agglutinate with ristocetin.
Inclusions are giant peroxidase-positive azurophilic/grey granules rather than pale-blue non-granular inclusions, and platelets are not giant.
Neutrophils lack cytoplasmic inclusions, and NMMHC-IIA immunofluorescence shows normal diffuse staining.
